title: Remarks on the Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture

definitions.statement: We give a brief description of the Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture and present related conjectures. We describe the relation between the nilpotent orbits of SL(2,R) and CM points.
